# Section 1

## Problem 1: use of inline R code, plotting, and ggplot

Install "palmerpenguins" package

Load "palmerpenguins" package
```{r}
data("penguins", package= "palmerpenguins")
```

Number of rows: `r nrow (penguins)` 
Number of columns: `r ncol (penguins)` variables.
Variables: `r ls (penguins)`. 
Mean flipper length is `r mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm=TRUE)`

Load tidyverse

Create scatter plot of flipper lenth vs bill length by species
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
ggplot(penguins, aes(bill_length_mm, y=flipper_length_mm, color=species)) + geom_point()
```

Export scatter plot as PDF
```{r}
ggsave("penguins_flipperbill.pdf", height=4, width=6)
```

# Section 2

## Problem 2: variable types
Create a data frame with 10 values from a Normal distribution

```{r}
hw1_df = tibble(norm_samp= rnorm(10), 
                norm_pos= norm_samp > 0, 
                vec_char= c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H", "I", "J"),
                vec_factor= factor(rnorm(10), levels=c("low", "medium", "high"))
                
  
)
```

Means of each variable in data frame
Normal Sample: `r mean(hw1_df$norm_samp)`
Logical Vector: `r mean(hw1_df$norm_pos)`
Character Vector: `r mean (hw1_df$vec_char)`-- character values cannot be averaged
Factor Vector: `r mean (hw1_df$vec_factor)`-- factor values cannot be averaged


Converting variables
```{r}
as.numeric(hw1_df$norm_pos, eval=FALSE)
as.numeric(hw1_df$vec_char, eval=FALSE)
as.numeric(hw1_df$vec_factor, eval=FALSE)
```
